description: Ten states of the maze's MDP, each with its value, the four moves' Q-values and the best move, from derive.py's own value iteration (spec/vectors/mdp/README.md).

cases.name: the-start
cases.description: The game's first state: all four pellets, Blinky above in the middle, heading left.
cases.heading: left

cases.name: one-pellet-one-step-away
cases.description: The last pellet is one step left and Blinky is far: take it and win.
cases.heading: down

cases.name: blinky-in-the-corridor-ahead
cases.description: Blinky is two cells to the right on the bottom row, heading at Pac-Man: turn away.
cases.heading: left

cases.name: blinky-right-behind
cases.description: Blinky one cell to the right on the top row, heading at Pac-Man: every move but left is caught.
cases.heading: left

cases.name: two-pellets-left-on-the-right
cases.description: The two right-hand pellets left, Blinky in the far left column.
cases.heading: down

cases.name: blinky-between-pac-man-and-the-pellet
cases.description: The last pellet is top right, and Blinky stands on the way to it.
cases.heading: left

cases.name: blinky-heading-away
cases.description: Blinky just above, heading away up the column; the bottom pellets left.
cases.heading: up

cases.name: the-middle-row
cases.description: Pac-Man halfway along the middle row, all four pellets left, Blinky coming along the row below.
cases.heading: right

cases.name: last-pellet-far-blinky-near
cases.description: One pellet left in the far corner, Blinky close behind Pac-Man.
cases.heading: right

cases.name: a-corner-with-blinky-across
cases.description: Pac-Man in the bottom-right corner just after its pellet, Blinky across the maze.
cases.heading: up
